note: Read-only consistency LINT of the whole SPEC corpus under .marvin/task (duplicate numbers, numbering holes, slug collisions, dangling depends_on, unsealed specs, invalid statuses, unidentified files). Distinct from adr-audit (decision records), refactor-audit (code structure), sec-scan (vulnerabilities) and task-start (authoring one spec). mock_rate encodes the ideal outcome for --decider mock; real deciders ignore it.
